definitions.short: properly, to twist as a rope; to bound (as by a line)
definitions.full: H1379. gabal גָּבַל verb denominative bound , border — Qal Perfect גָָּֽבְּלוּ Deut 19:14 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִגְבּוֺל Josh 18:20 , 3 feminine singular תִּגְבָּלֿ Zech 9:2 ; — bound, border , with accusative Josh 18:20 (P); with בְּ border upon, adjoin Zech 9:2 ; transitive set bounds Deut 10:14 (with accusative of congnate meaning with verb). Hiph`il Perfect 2masculine singular set bounds for , with accusative וְהִגְבַּלְתָּ֫ Exod 19:12 ; Imperative id. הַגְבֵּל 19:23 (both J E), + Participle מַגְבִּיל Ezek 47:18 ᵑ9 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Co.
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; also as a denominative from 1366
